title: Alpha limitations
subtitle: What is intentionally out of scope
description: Known gaps and parked features for 0.1.0-alpha.

sections.title: Save does not apply mutator result as data
sections.content: On success: `resetDraft` only. Refresh source via query invalidate → refetch, store update, or `setData`.

sections.title: Collection parked
sections.content: No first-class Collection / per-row form registry in this alpha. Build list UIs with your own keys + nested providers.

sections.title: React primary DX
sections.content: Core is usable anywhere; richest DX is `qortex-form-react` + optional `/query` and `/store` binders.
